# Tiferes Execution Graph

> The Awtsmoos renews Chesed and Gevurah into one ordered beauty; Awtsmoos.com makes every next action carry implementation, evidence, ownership, and duty.

## Wave A — six concurrent verification lanes

A1. New lifecycle input/planning parity + cache authority/failure + demo contract/safety tests.
A2. Existing universal/compiler/constraint/default-compiler regression suite.
A3. Package subpath + recursive static import graph proof.
A4. Structural gate across all changed JS/MJS/CSS/HTML including test helpers.
A5. Full package test universe; compare new failures against known 19-red baseline.
A6. Static server + fresh Chrome v3 readiness preparation.

## Wave B — browser proof

B1. Fresh cache-busted demo target.
B2. Unknown query fallback and canonical query rewrite.
B3. Five scenario receipts + 15 pipeline stages + expected unresolved counts.
B4. Compile-again miss -> hit.
B5. Arrow/Home/End navigation and focus.
B6. Modifier-key guards and editable-target guards.
B7. Rapid-selection generation race check.
B8. Workspace busy/live/status final state.
B9. Nine summary cards including timing/primitives/pipeline support.
B10. 320px and 390px no-overflow.
B11. Same-origin resource audit and lifecycle core-module measurement.
B12. Zero exceptions / console errors / severe logs.

## Wave C — closure artifacts

C1. Update performance doc with v3 browser measurements.
C2. Rewrite EVIDENCE_LEDGER from exact jobs/results.
C3. Write PLANNED_VS_ACTUAL_DELTA and resolve every release-important delta.
C4. Search TODO/FIXME/dead new modules/stale version assumptions.
C5. Build explicit mission file manifest.

## Wave D — Git integration

D1. Refresh branch/HEAD/origin and fetch.
D2. Create clean worktree from fresh origin/main.
D3. Transfer mission patch/files only.
D4. Inspect diff; ensure no unrelated quantity/Reality/Nature/tunnel/editor/emulator work.
D5. Run critical tests/import graph/structural gate inside integration worktree.
D6. Commit coherent tranche.
D7. Fresh fetch and fast-forward safety proof.
D8. Push and verify remote main SHA.

## Wave E — release/public proof

E1. Re-read `bhRelease.mjs` and deploy helper from integration state.
E2. Run prepare with explicit intended SHA/message.
E3. Run activate on exact pushed SHA.
E4. Verify production worktree and origin SHA.
E5. Fresh public browser E2E on canonical route.
E6. Verify same-origin resources and lifecycle composition publicly.
E7. Update ledgers/docs with release SHA and public evidence.
E8. Remove temporary worktrees/server/browser only after durable evidence exists.
E9. Run completion, embarrassment, takeover, and unknown-work discovery gates.
E10. Empty REMAINING_WORK only if no safe useful work remains.
